evals.prompt: Hey can you commit my staged changes? I just added a password strength checker to the auth module.
evals.expected_output: A conventional commit message of type 'feat' with scope 'auth', a concise imperative description, optionally a body if the diff warrants it, and the commit actually applied to the repo.

assertions.name: type-is-feat
assertions.description: Commit message first line starts with 'feat'

assertions.name: description-is-imperative
assertions.description: Description uses an imperative verb (add, implement, introduce, etc.), not past or present-continuous tense

assertions.name: first-line-under-72-chars
assertions.description: The first line of the commit message is 72 characters or fewer

assertions.name: commit-was-applied
assertions.description: git log --oneline -1 shows a new commit (not the initial 'chore: initial scaffold' commit)

evals.prompt: Write a commit message for what I just changed and commit it.

assertions.name: type-is-fix

assertions.name: description-mentions-404-or-status
